inviteLinks.title: Card about the product's mobile app.
inviteLinks.intro: Intro of the card about the product's mobile app. $t(common:product) inserts the product's name (Socio); keep it as is. Invite links open the mobile app on phones, or the web page without it.
inviteLinks.toggle: Switch on the app card: invite links open the mobile app on phones instead of the web page.
inviteLinks.description: “Send me a link for the app” quotes a button on the sign-in page: keep it matching. https is a protocol name.
inviteLinks.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
policy.title: Card: rules for the mobile app's offline copy of the workspace.
policy.intro: Intro of the card with the rules for the mobile app's offline copy of the workspace. $t(common:product) inserts the product's name (Socio); keep it as is.
policy.leaseDays.label: Field label, followed by a number field and then policy.leaseDays.unit, reading as one sentence: "Lock the app after [30] days without reaching the workspace".
policy.leaseDays.unit: Follows the number field after policy.leaseDays.label.
policy.wipeDays.label: Field label, followed by a number field and then policy.wipeDays.unit: "Then erase its copy after [30] more days".
policy.wipeDays.unit: Follows the number field after policy.wipeDays.label.
policy.periods: Explanation under the two day fields (lock after, then erase after) on the offline copy card: what happens when a phone goes that long without reaching the workspace.
policy.invalidDays: {{min}} and {{max}} are the allowed range of days.
policy.saved: Toast after the lock and erase periods saved.
policy.appLock.title: Switch: the mobile app asks for Face ID or a fingerprint before it opens this workspace.
policy.appLock.description: Face ID is Apple's product name: keep it.
policy.notificationText.title: Switch: phone notifications show the text of the new message, or only that something new came.
policy.notificationText.description: Description under the switch that shows message text in phone notifications: on by default; when off, notifications say only that something new came.
policy.notificationText.saved: Toast after the switch saved; the _off form is for when it was turned off.
policy.versions: Note at the bottom of the offline copy card: older versions of the mobile app follow only the lock and erase periods; the app lock and notification text switches need a newer version.
logs.title: Card: how long the logs of mini apps (small apps people build in the workspace) are kept.
logs.intro: Intro of the card on how long mini app logs are kept; mini apps are small apps people build in the workspace. An attempt is one build and start of an app; the fields below set the days and the number of attempts.
logs.days.label: Field label, followed by a number field and logs.days.unit: "Keep for [14] days".
logs.days.unit: Follows the number field after logs.days.label.
logs.attempts.label: Field label, followed by a number field and logs.attempts.unit: "Or keep the last [5] attempts per app".
logs.attempts.unit: Follows the number field after logs.attempts.label.
logs.invalid: Toast when a field holds a number out of range: {{min}} to {{max}}.
logs.saved: Toast after the mini app log settings saved.
